qvdr: Read QVD Files from QlikView and Qlik Sense

Source: R/qvdr-package.R
qvdr-package.Rd

The qvdr package reads QVD (QlikView Data) binary files — Qlik's proprietary high-performance columnar format — into R tibbles.

Key functions

  • read_qvd(): Read a QVD file into a tibble (main entry point)

  • qvd_metadata(): Read only the header metadata (fast)

  • qvd_fields(): List field names in a QVD file

  • qvd_schema(): Get detailed schema including R types and distinct counts

QVD format notes

A QVD file has three sections:

  1. XML header: metadata including field names, types, Qlik tags, and layout parameters for the bit-packed data section.

  2. Symbol table: per-field dictionaries of all unique values, encoded as typed entries (int32, double, or null-terminated string).

  3. Data section: a bit-packed record matrix where each row's fields are encoded as variable-width indices into the symbol table.

The bit-extraction inner loop is implemented in C++ via Rcpp::Rcpp for performance. Reading a 1 million-row, 20-column QVD file typically completes in 1–3 seconds on a modern machine.
